bind_address.description: IP address on which glusterd listens for incoming connections.

listen_port.description: TCP port for glusterd management traffic (must match across cluster).

nodelay.description: Disable Nagle’s algorithm to reduce latency on socket communication.

keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive probes to detect dead peers.

keepalive_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between keepalive probes after initial inactivity.

keepalive_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before closing connection after keepalive failure.

linger.description: Enable SO_LINGER to control socket shutdown behavior.

rmem.description: TCP receive buffer size in bytes (kernel adjusts up to this).

wmem.description: TCP send buffer size in bytes (kernel adjusts up to this).

items.description: CIDR or hostname patterns allowed for RPC authentication (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24', 'gluster1.example.com').

auth_allow.description: List of clients permitted to connect to glusterd.

items.description: CIDR or hostname patterns explicitly denied access.

auth_reject.description: List of clients denied from connecting to glusterd.

auth_password_file.description: Path to file containing basic auth credentials (for LDAP fallback or legacy auth).

ldap_bind_dn.description: LDAP DN used to bind to the LDAP server (for authentication).

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN.

ldap_search_base_dn.description: Base DN for LDAP user/group searches.

ldap_search_filter.description: LDAP search filter string; %s is replaced with username.

ldap_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for LDAPS/TLS verification.

ldap_use_starttls.description: Enable STARTTLS for LDAP (non-SSL connection upgraded to TLS).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, or NONE.

volfile_format.description: Format of volume files: 'native' (Gluster’s own format) or 'xml'.

volume_root.description: Root directory for GlusterFS metadata and configuration files.

peer_statistics.description: Enable collection of peer statistics for metrics and monitoring.

client_port.description: Lower bound for client RPC port range (glusterfsd connections).

server_port.description: Lower bound for server RPC port range (glusterd-to-server connections).

num_threads.description: Number of RPC worker threads to handle concurrent client requests.

insecure_access.description: Allow RPC connections from non-privileged ports (insecure; disables port-checking).

server_allow_insecure.description: Allow 'insecure' client mounts (e.g., without Kerberos or SSL).

mgmt_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for glusterd-to-glusterd management traffic.

mgmt_ssl_cipher_list.description: OpenSSL cipher list for management-plane SSL/TLS.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP of peer node.

uuid.description: UUID of peer node (optional; auto-discovered on first connect).

peers.description: List of static peer nodes (used for cluster bootstrap or DNS-less setups).
